content.trans: 中文名：英语播客

content.text: Oh no, the lights went out. Honey, can you light a candle?
content.trans: 抱歉，灯熄灭了。 honey，你能点燃蜡烛吗？

content.text: Sure, what do we do now?
content.trans: 好的，我们现在做什么？

content.text: Well, we can just talk, you know, like we used to.
content.trans: 嗯，我们还是聊一聊吧，你知道的，就像以前一样。

content.text: I know, I'll tell you a scary story.
content.trans: 我知道，我将告诉你一个恐怖的故事。

content.text: It happened to me and my dad when I was a teenager.
content.trans: 我年轻时和我的父亲一起经历了一件事。

content.text: I was living with my father at the time when he received a phone call.
content.trans: 我在他接到电话时，与我父亲同住。

content.text: Hello? Yes, this is him.
content.trans: 你好？是的，这是他。

content.text: I see. Sorry to hear that.
content.trans: 我看到。抱歉听到这个消息。

content.text: Okay, no problem. I'll be there shortly.
content.trans: 好的，没问题。我一会儿就到。

content.text: Pack some clothes, Tony. My great aunt is very ill and known in the family wants to take care of her.
content.trans: 包些衣服，托尼。我大伯很不舒服，家里人想照顾她。

content.text: We're going to stay at her house for a few days.
content.trans: 我们打算在她家呆几天。

content.text: And? What aunt? I never knew you had a great aunt.
content.trans: 而且？你是什么人？我从没听说过你是个有大舅的。

content.text: Well, the family doesn't talk about her or getting near her for that matter.
content.trans: 嗯，家庭不谈论她或者接近她。

content.text: Why is that?
content.trans: 为什么是这个？

content.text: Come on, we have to go.
content.trans: 来吧，我们得走了。

content.text: So we arrived at this old house on the outskirts of our town.
content.trans: 所以我们到达了这个老房子的边缘，我们的村子附近。

content.text: There was almost no one around and the house had an eerie look to it.
content.trans: 几乎没有人，房子看起来有些诡异。

content.text: Once inside the house, we walked to her room and I was surprised to find my dad's great aunt in a wheelchair, yelling at someone.
content.trans: 在房子里，我们走进了她的房间，我被惊讶地发现我的爸爸的伯母坐在轮椅上，大声喊着有人。

content.text: But we were alone in the room.
content.trans: 但是我们在房间里独处。

content.text: Hi, Anersawa. This is my son, Tony.
content.trans: 你好，阿尼萨瓦。这是我儿子托尼的翻译。

content.text: Why have you come? Why are you here? Don't you know it is in safe?
content.trans: 为什么你来了？为什么在这里？你不明白这是安全的吗？

content.text: My time is near. He's coming for me.
content.trans: 我的时间近了。他将来见我。

content.text: Who is coming for you?
content.trans: 谁来迎接你？

content.text: The pranks of darkness, the lord of the underworld, the tempter, the old serpent.
content.trans: 黑暗中的游戏，黑暗的主宰，欺骗者，旧蛇。

content.text: Come on, Anersawa. Let's lay you down.
content.trans: 来吧，安赛娃。让我们把您放下来。

content.text: We need to get some rest. Tony, help me lay her down.
content.trans: 我们需要休息一下。托尼，帮我把她放下来。

content.text: That night, we slept in one of the 12 rooms of that big old mansion.
content.trans: 那晚，我们睡在那个大老房子里的12间大房间里。

content.text: The trees outside seem to come alive and their shadows formed ghoulish shapes on my bed.
content.trans: 外面的树似乎在活，它们的影子形成了诡异的形状在我的床上。

content.text: All of a sudden, we heard screaming.
content.trans: 突然，我们听到尖叫。

content.text: Hi, I'm Dan. I want to get taken.
content.trans: 你好，我是丹。我想被带走。

content.text: Dad, dad, dad. Something is attacking Aunt Ursula.
content.trans: 爸爸，爸爸，爸爸。有些东西正在攻击乌苏拉阿姨。

content.text: Back to the other room, you see that? I shall be done before you can take you.
content.trans: 回到另一间房间，你看得到吗？我将完成之前的一切。

content.text: The door is jammed. Stand back.
content.trans: 门关上了。站远一点。

content.text: Anersula, where are you? Over here.
content.trans: 对不起，我无法直接翻译中文到中文。不过，根据您提供的信息，“Anersula, where are you?” 这句话在中文中可以被理解为“安瑞莎，你在哪里？”或者“安瑞莎，你在哪儿？” 翻译成英文是 “Anersula, where are you? Over here.” 请注意，这只是一个假设的翻译，并且可能不准确。如果您有其他问题或需要进一步的帮助，请随时告诉我！

content.text: And as we approached her, she was lying on the floor with her hands and feet open like the Vitruvian men,
content.trans: 当我们靠近她时，她躺在地上，双手和双脚都张开，就像维特鲁威的雕像。

content.text: breathing heavily with bloody marks and scratches on her arms, legs and face.
content.trans: 呼吸急促，手臂、腿部和面部都有血迹和划痕。

content.text: Remember how I mentioned that she was in a wheelchair?
content.trans: 记得我曾经提到她坐轮椅吗？

content.text: My aunt had been paralyzed from the neck down for just over a year.
content.trans: 我的姑姑因为颈部以下的瘫痪已经持续了将近一年。

content.text: After this incident, strange things would happen in the house, and my aunt would yell and scream,
content.trans: 在这件事之后，家里的事情会变得奇怪，我姑姑就会大喊大叫。

content.text: according to her, warding off the evil that had come to get her.
content.trans: 根据她的话，抵御她所遭受的邪恶。

content.text: As the days passed, she became very weak and eventually was unable to talk.
content.trans: 随着日子一天天过去，她变得越来越虚弱，最终无法说话。

content.text: My dad had to work during the day, so I was left to care for her.
content.trans: 我的爸爸在白天要工作，所以我一个人照顾她。

content.text: When she lost her voice and laid on her deathbed, I would hear her breathe in and out.
content.trans: 当她失声且在临终时，我会听到她的呼吸进出。

content.text: Until finally one day, she breathed in and never exhaled.
content.trans: 直到最后，她终于呼吸了进去，再也没有呼出。

content.text: That night, I felt relieved that it was finally over, but it wasn't.
content.trans: 那天晚上，我感到非常释然，但并没有结束。

content.text: I was so terrified of what I was hearing that I didn't sleep all night.
content.trans: 我太害怕听到的了，以至于整夜没睡。

content.text: The following morning, I went to the bathroom, expecting to find a mess and everything torn up.
content.trans: 早上，我去了厕所，期待着会发现一团糟和东西都破了。

content.text: But I found everything exactly as it was before.
content.trans: 但是，我找到了一切与之前一样。

content.text: The movers came that same day, and as we were cleaning out her drawers and personal items,
content.trans: 搬运员那天就来了，我们正在清理她的抽屉和个人物品。

content.text: we found strange notebooks with names and amounts of money written next to them.
content.trans: 我们发现有奇怪的笔记本，上面写着名字和金额。

content.text: We found pictures with people's faces sewn with black or red string.
content.trans: 我们找到了用黑色或红色丝线缝合的人脸的照片。

content.text: And you want to know what the strangest thing was?
content.trans: 您想知道什么最奇怪的事情吗？

content.text: There was a small doll filled with dead ants, with a strand of hair tied around its waist.
content.trans: 这里有一个装满死蚂蚁的小娃娃，绑着一条头发。

content.text: And on the doll's face, there was a picture of me with the numbers 31-10-09.
content.trans: 在娃娃的脸蛋上，有一张我用数字31-10-09画的图。

content.text: You know what date it is today?
content.trans: 您知道今天是哪一天吗？

content.text: It's over 31st, 2009.
